description: You can follow a returned function that keeps its captured argument.

steps.description: make_adder returns a function of x whose body adds n. The returned function and its captured environment form a closure.
You call make_adder with 5 and bind the returned function to add5. Its addition uses that captured value of n.

steps.answer: It returns 15 by adding x equal to 10 to the captured n equal to 5.
steps.question: What does add5(10) return?

steps.description: You see 15 and 25 printed for the two calls. Each call supplies a new x while using the same captured 5.

title: Returning an adder function
